page.heading: Me
page.intro: Your consent choices, interests, security and referrals.

consent.heading: Consent controls
consent.intro: The same three choices from sign-up, still separate. Turning any of these off is exactly as easy as turning it on — nothing extra to confirm either way.
consent.essentialBody: Keeps your account working and confirms your phone hasn't registered before. Can't be turned off without deleting your account below.
consent.personalizeBody: Uses your declared interests to sort the Earn board. Off, and you still see every campaign — just not sorted for you.
consent.marketingBody: SMS or WhatsApp about new campaigns, rewards or promotions.
consent.personalizePreviewOnWithInterests: Your Earn board would show {interests} first.
consent.personalizePreviewOnNoInterests: Personalised sort is on, but you haven't chosen any interests yet — pick some below and the board will use them.
consent.personalizePreviewOff: Your Earn board order: default, not personalised to you.
consent.marketingPreviewOnBody: YourTal: a new campaign from Kopi Kenangan just opened — earn up to 800 points in 3 minutes.

interests.heading: Your interests
interests.intro: Used to sort the Earn board when personalisation above is on. Change these anytime — nothing is permanent.

language.heading: Language & region
language.intro: Your region sets your language and currency together, chosen once at sign-up.
language.fixedNote: Region can't be changed in this build, the same rule the sign-up screen states — it also determines which consumer protections and currency apply to your account.

security.heading: Security
security.intro: What each control actually does, plainly — not oversold.
security.otpBody: Confirms this phone number hasn't been used to register before. It does not verify who you are, and this prototype keeps no record of your verified number to display here.
security.passkeyBody: Lets you skip typing a one-time code on this device. It's a convenience, not proof of identity, and by itself it doesn't make an account harder to take over.
security.prototypeNote: Prototype: this only stores a label on this device. No real passkey is created or checked.

referrals.heading: Referrals
referrals.intro: Share your code with friends. Referral rewards are not switched on in this build — sharing doesn't grant points to either of you yet.

deleteAccount.heading: Delete your account
deleteAccount.intro: This permanently removes your YourTal account on this device. Before you confirm, here is exactly what happens — there is no cash refund for any of it.
deleteAccount.bulletPoints: Unspent points are forfeited, including anything on hold or about to expire. None of it can be paid out as cash or transferred to anyone else.
deleteAccount.bulletVouchers: Vouchers already in your wallet keep their code and can still be redeemed by the merchant until they expire — but you won't be able to log back in to view them, so save or screenshot any you plan to use first.
deleteAccount.confirmCheckboxLabel: I understand my unspent points will be forfeited and this can't be undone.
deleteAccount.completedBody: This prototype cleared your consent, interest and security choices on this device. YourTal has no live account-deletion endpoint yet — a real request would be queued for processing and would follow the forfeiture rules above.
